name: 文森特·哈尔特
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:234
who: Vincent Hart, a human swordsman and one of the legends who lived through the Black Tide, a hundred and fifty-six years old but looking forty-seven or forty-eight ever since he became a legend at sixty: about 188 cm, tall, thin and long-limbed, standing like a sword leaned against a wall. Long white hair with a faint blue tint, gone white the year his eyes were burned, falling past the shoulders and tied at the back with an old leather cord. He is blind: both eyes are open but veiled with a bluish-white frost like frosted glass, and when he faces someone he faces the space beside their shoulder. He tilts his head a little to the left, the right ear forward; the right earlobe has a small piece missing. A slow, quiet air with a dry, unsmiling humour.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, long, mature man's face of about forty-seven, NOT old: fine lines at the eye corners and between the brows, a straight nose, a thin firm mouth with a dry humour in it; narrow almond eyes, both open, the irises and pupils veiled by a pale bluish-white frost like frosted glass, no clear pupil, the gaze unfocused and resting a little to one side of the viewer; straight pale eyebrows. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft cool tone.
build: 188 cm, tall, thin and long-limbed: narrow shoulders, arms a little longer than most, a straight back.
palette: faded deep blue and frost white, worn leather brown, a thin line of pale ether cyan
casual: His everyday gear: an old deep-blue cloak, patched many times, its hem a hand shorter at one place where two strips were torn off; under it faded leather armour over a dark shirt, dark trousers and worn boots. At his left hip a long sword in a plain scabbard, a thin line of pale ether crystal set along the spine of the blade; its grip is wrapped with two turns of the same faded deep-blue cloth, wound so that it leaves one spare loop just big enough for a finger, and the loop is empty. A small copper bell on his left wrist. He stands very straight with the head tilted a little to the left, the left hand on the sword grip, the thumb resting beside the empty loop, a calm, dry look.
private: At home in his bare room behind the north boundary stone of the shaft: a plain undyed linen shirt buttoned to the collar, a dark wool waistcoat, dark trousers and soft house shoes, the hair tied back with the old leather cord, no cloak. He turns a small polished whetstone between his fingers, a piece of his father's grinding wheel. A quiet, listening look with the faintest smile.
battle: Leading a line of people through the floor that swallows lamplight: the deep-blue cloak belted close, the faded leather armour buckled tight with leather bracers, the copper bell taken off his wrist and tied to a guide rope at his belt. He holds the long sword in both hands low in front of him, the blade angled down, the empty cloth loop on the grip, the ether line along the blade glowing faintly; his head is tilted to listen, a still, intent look.
formal: As a legend at the Ceasefire Day reading of names: a long dark navy swallowtail coat with a flat open collar and a row of small brass buttons over a grey waistcoat and white shirt, dark gloves, the guild's bronze rank emblem of the highest grade, a seven-pointed star in a ring, on a cord at the chest, the old deep-blue cloak over his shoulders, the sword at his hip with the empty loop still on its grip, the ether line in its scabbard glowing faintly through the leather. He stands very straight with the hands folded in front, a grave, quiet look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the frosted blind eyes turned a little past the viewer, the head tilted to listen, a faint dry half-smile. A pale dawn-white light rises from one side, as if from a chasm below, and warms that side of his face. Foreground blur: the empty cloth loop of the sword grip, drifting small white feathers and the dim pale railings of a bridge. He wears the patched deep-blue cloak over faded leather armour.
art_extra: His long hair is white with only the faintest cool tint, exactly as in the sprite, on its lit side and its shadow side alike; its shadows a darker neutral grey, NOT blue, violet, lavender or pink; the coloured light only rims its outermost edge.

name: 萝珊·温特
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:290
who: Roxane Winter, a half-elf scout who walks ahead of the guild's deep-level parties, thirty-two but looking twenty-two or twenty-three: about 166 cm, slim and light, long-legged, landing toes first when she walks. Misty lilac-purple hair cut straight at the chin; ears only slightly pointed, a little more than a human's, showing even under a hood. Amber-gold eyes that seldom blink and can hold one thing for half a day. A faint thin scar across the bridge of the nose from a fall at nine. A strip of black cloth wound round her left wrist, never taken off. A quick, exact, stubborn air: she reports a number before anything else.
build: 166 cm, slim and light: a small bust, a narrow waist and slim hips, long legs.
palette: misty lilac and grey-green, warm amber gold, polished bronze, a little black
casual: Her scout's gear: a grey-green short cloak with the hood always pushed back, a fitted dark grey-green tunic, a narrow belt hung with a coil of thin cord and a small box of charcoal sticks, slim trousers and soft boots, a short bow on her back; the guild's bronze star-chart rank emblem, an astrolabe with linked stars, on a cord at the chest; a strip of black cloth wound round her left wrist. In one hand she holds an extendable probe pole with a palm-sized round bronze mirror at its tip, for looking round corners, held low at an angle. An alert, sharp look.
private: Off duty in her attic behind the survey bureau: a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves pushed up, a dark knitted vest, slim grey trousers and soft shoes, the hair a little messy, the black strip still on her wrist. She holds the small bronze mirror, unscrewed from its pole, face down in her palm without looking into it. A quiet, thoughtful look.
battle: Scouting the deep floors: the grey-green short cloak, fitted dark leather armour, a leather bracer on the bow arm, a quiver of grey-fletched arrows at the hip, the mirror-tipped probe pole slung across her back. She holds the short bow with an arrow nocked and the string not drawn, held low and ready. A sharp, unblinking look.
formal: At the survey bureau's showing of the new deep-floor maps: a fitted dark slate-grey short jacket with a rolled collar and small brass buttons over a pale shirt and a thin knotted tie, a narrow belt with a brass surveyor's compass, slim dark trousers and polished boots, the bronze star-chart rank emblem pinned at the chest, the black strip still on her left wrist, a small crystal bead on her lapel that traces the room's drafts. She stands very straight with the hands folded in front, a composed, serious look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the amber-gold eyes looking at the viewer without blinking, a small stubborn smile. She holds the round bronze mirror on its pole up beside her face, a flash of white dawn light caught in it and thrown across her cheek from one side. Foreground blur: the bronze rim of the mirror, the trailing end of the black wrist strip and drifting dust. She wears the grey-green short cloak with the hood pushed back.
art_extra: Her misty lilac-purple hair is cut straight at the chin and ends there, exactly as in the sprite, NOT longer; it keeps the sprite's soft greyish lilac, NOT vivid pink-purple.

name: 提珀·鬃刷
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:346
who: Tipper, a halfling from a family of boot-and-armour brushers at the shaft mouth, the washer of the guild's recovery department who cleans the belongings of the dead before they go home, sixty-two: about 98 cm, small, round-shouldered and solid. Ginger hair in short curls cropped close to the scalp. Round, bright emerald-green eyes that look at what people wear before their faces. Grey grime that never washes out from under the nails of his big hands. A small brush always tucked behind his left ear. A chattering, haggling air, though anything put in his hands is handled more gently than by anyone.
build: 98 cm, small and round, with short thick arms and big hands.
palette: ginger orange and emerald green, oilcloth olive-brown, soap white, a little copper
casual: His washer's gear: an oilcloth apron with pockets sewn one beside another, a dozen brushes of every size standing in them, over a long-sleeved dark shirt with rolled cuffs; brown trousers and sturdy little boots; on his back a wooden washing chest on straps; thin leather gloves tucked in the apron string; the guild's bronze key-and-door-ring rank emblem on a cord; a small brush behind his left ear. He holds a stiff-bristled brush in one bare hand, a shrewd, cheerful half-smile.
private: In the recovery department's wash house after hours: the apron off, a loose cream shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a brown waistcoat with a bulging pocket, brown trousers and slippers, the brush still behind his ear. He counts a handful of copper coins from one palm into the other, a satisfied, haggler's grin.
battle: Going down with a recovery team: the recovery department's deep grey heavy wool coat cut to his size, leather pads sewn on the shoulders, the oilcloth apron of brushes tied over it, thin leather gloves on, the wooden washing chest strapped tight on his back, a small shielded lantern at his belt. He grips the shoulder straps of the chest and carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the descent outfit: braced and steady, the feet a little wider and planted, a firm, unsmiling expression, both hands gripping the shoulder straps of the wooden washing chest on his back; he carries no weapon.
formal: Handing the belongings of the dead back to a family: his one good coat, a dark brown wool short coat with wooden buttons over a clean white shirt, the bronze guild emblem on its cord, polished little boots, the brush still behind his ear. He holds in both hands a small washed bundle tied with fine hemp thread in a single knot, standing very straight, a quiet, respectful look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the round green eyes looking at the viewer with a shrewd, warm look, one big hand lifting a soft brush near his cheek. Warm yellow lamplight of the wash house from one side. Foreground blur: drifting soap bubbles, a fine hemp thread tied in a knot and a few loose bristles. He wears the oilcloth apron full of brushes.
face_extra: Faint smile lines at the corners of the eyes and mouth show his age, on the same round face.

name: 娜佳·刻期
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:537
who: Nadja, a demon-kin woman of the bull-horned Thunder-Gaol folk, from the family that carves release dates into prison doors, a hundred and four but looking just over twenty: about 186 cm, tall, broad-shouldered and strong-armed, standing like a well-shut door. Deep bronze-coloured skin. Two horns curving forward; on the root of the left horn five fine notches she carved herself, one for each year. Hair cut at the chin, the pale lavender of the sky's edge before lightning, whitening at the tips. Pale cyan eyes that look at people slowly. A slow, steady, stubborn air: she remembers everyone's birthday and cannot add up her own wages.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young woman's face of about twenty, calm and strong-boned, with a firm jaw and a straight nose; medium, gently slanted almond eyes of pale cyan, slow and steady, with a thin tapering upper lash line; level dark brows; a closed, patient mouth. Deep bronze-coloured skin with very little shading, the skin shadows a soft warm brown.
build: 186 cm, tall and solid: broad shoulders and a strong back, strong arms, a full bust, a firm waist and full hips.
palette: deep bronze and black iron, pale lavender and pale cyan, worn wood brown
casual: Her travelling clothes: a black-iron-coloured short coat with the cuffs bound in leather over a long coarse linen robe, its hem tucked up into the belt, dark leggings and heavy boots. A folding stool strapped on her back, its four legs all the same length, the seat branded with her family's mark, the shape of a door. A tool pouch at her waist holds a short chisel, its handle worn shiny by her grandfather's hand, and a small hammer; a war hammer with a chisel-edged head hangs at the back of her belt; the guild's bronze key-and-door-ring rank emblem on a cord. She stands with the hands loose at her sides, a slow, steady look.
private: At home in the families' quarter of the Thunder-Gaol city: a long-sleeved dark grey wool dress to the shins, belted, thick knitted stockings and soft boots, the folding stool under one arm. With the other thumb she touches the five notches on the root of her left horn. A quiet, inward look.
battle: Ready in the deep: the black-iron short coat buttoned to the collar over a boiled-leather jerkin, leather bracers, the long linen robe tucked up short, heavy boots, the folding stool strapped tight on her back. She grips the war hammer with the chisel-edged head in both hands across her body, a level, unmoving look.
formal: At a prison gate on the morning a sentence ends: a black wool cutaway coat with a deep fold-down collar over a grey waistcoat, the door-shaped family mark embroidered small on the lapel, a pale grey sash, polished boots, a brass key-ring hung from the belt. She holds her grandfather's chisel and small hammer together in both hands in front of her, standing very upright, a solemn, patient look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale cyan eyes looking at the viewer slowly and steadily, a thumb resting on the five notches at the root of her left horn. Cold violet-white light from one side, like the moment before lightning. Foreground blur: small brass gears, drifting sparks of white light and the edge of a riveted iron door. She wears the black-iron short coat over the coarse linen robe.
art_extra: Her hair is the very pale, almost white lavender of the sprite, whitening at the tips, NOT saturated violet or purple, and it is cut at the chin and ends there. Her face is the same soft feminine face as in the sprite, not a hard frown.

name: 瑞秋·晨炉
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:593
who: Rachel, a human baker's daughter from the Laundry-Line Lane and the line-snapper of the rescue corps, twenty-four: about 163 cm, compact and strong, her arms sturdy from kneading dough; she can carry a person up two floors. Coral-pink hair in one thick braid, the end tied with a length of white cotton thread; a band of freckles across the bridge of the nose; mint-green eyes that smile before her mouth does. A faint dust of flour on the backs of her hands and between the fingers. A warm, quick, chattering air, though she often stops herself halfway through a sentence.
build: 163 cm, sturdy and strong: strong arms from kneading dough, a medium bust, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: coral pink and mint green, rescue grey-blue, flour white, a little bronze
casual: Her rescue-corps gear: a grey-blue short jacket with a white stripe sewn round the left sleeve, a cream shirt underneath, brown trousers and sturdy boots. On her back a line box twice the size of an ordinary chalk-line box, a bronze plumb bob fixed to its side, the lid shut; at the belt a bag of white chalk, a bag of hard bread and a short knife for cutting line; the guild's bronze key-and-door-ring rank emblem on a cord. She holds a heel of bread in one hand and winds the white line round two fingers of the other, a bright, chatty smile.
private: At home in the family bakery halfway up the lane's steps: a cream linen blouse with the sleeves rolled up, a long brown wool skirt, a flour-dusted apron, the braid over one shoulder. She holds a round loaf from the first batch of the morning, still warm, against her chest. A warm, sleepy, happy look.
battle: On a rescue descent: the grey-blue jacket buttoned up with the white stripe on the left arm, a boiled-leather vest over it, leather gloves and knee pads, the big line box strapped tight on her back, the bags of chalk and bread at her belt. She holds a white chalk line pulled taut between both hands, ready to snap it straight.
battle_pose: 3) the rescue outfit: braced and ready, the feet a little wider and planted, a firm expression, holding a white chalk line pulled taut between both hands; she carries only a small line-cutting knife at the belt and does not fight.
formal: Called to the guild master's office, for once through the front door: a clean deep-blue wool jacket worn open over a white shirt with an open collar and a lane-folk embroidered vest in flour white, the bronze guild emblem on its cord, the braid freshly tied with new white thread, a pinch of warm flour-dust that glows faintly on her cuffs. She holds a small round loaf wrapped in a white cloth in both hands in front of her, very upright, a gentle, serious look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the mint-green eyes smiling at the viewer before the mouth does, a white line held taut between two fingers near her cheek. Warm golden light from an opened oven door on one side. Foreground blur: drifting flour dust, a snapped chalk line and the crust of a loaf. She wears the grey-blue rescue jacket with the white stripe.

name: 杜戈·岩踵
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:649
who: Dugo, son of Ruda, a half-orc and the chief of the guild's deepest camp on the fiftieth floor, sixty but looking about fifty: about 193 cm, wide and thick, big-footed, standing in a tide like a driven stake. Thick grey-green skin; two lower tusks curving upward. Both temples shaved, a strip of short brick-red mane on top threaded with a few white hairs. Orange-yellow eyes that glow at night like two unshaded lamps. Ears much larger than other half-orcs', the rims flaring forward, twitching when he listens. A carved wooden cup hangs at his neck on a leather cord. He goes barefoot, the soles thick as leather. A heavy, slow-spoken, patient air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a weathered half-orc face of about fifty, broad and heavy-boned: two lower tusks curving up from the jaw past the upper lip; narrow orange-yellow eyes under a heavy brow, a few deep lines at their corners; a broad flat nose; a closed, set mouth. Large ears, much bigger than most half-orcs', the rims flaring forward like listening hands. Grey-green skin with very little shading, skin shadows a soft cool olive.
build: 193 cm, wide and thick: a broad chest, heavy shoulders and big bare feet.
palette: grey-green and brick red, lamp orange, worn leather brown, a little iron grey
casual: His camp chief's gear: thick cured-leather armour with a few iron plates nailed on the shoulders over a coarse wool shirt, dark trousers rolled at the ankle, bare feet; the camp register wrapped in oilcloth at his belt; the carved wooden cup on its leather cord at his neck; the guild's bronze star-chart rank emblem on a cord. He holds a long-handled spiked mace low at his side, its head forged from iron left over from the camp stakes, a calm, listening look.
private: Off watch in the camp at night: a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up, the leather armour off, wide trousers, barefoot, the wooden cup at his neck. He holds the camp register open in one big hand and a stub of pencil in the other, writing down his ten steps one line at a time. A quiet, thoughtful look.
battle: Crossing the tide: the leather armour with the iron-plated shoulders buckled tight, leather bracers, bare feet planted wide, the register tucked into the belt. He grips the long-handled spiked mace in both hands across his body, the big ears turned forward, a steady, braced look.
formal: Going up to the guild hall for the council's review, boots on for once: a heavy dark grey wool coat with plain iron buttons over a clean shirt, the leather armour left in camp, the bronze star-chart emblem on its cord, the wooden cup polished at his neck, the mane brushed. He holds the oilcloth-wrapped register in both hands in front of him, standing very upright, a gruff, slightly uncomfortable look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the head turned so one big forward-flaring ear faces the viewer, the orange-yellow eyes half closed, listening. Cold brass-yellow light from one side, as if through a wall of fog. Foreground blur: drifting fog, a taut rope with a small brass clip on it and the wooden cup on its cord. He wears the leather armour with iron on the shoulders.

name: 盖文·霍兰
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:845
who: Gavin Holland, a human swordsman of a young party, twenty-one: about 186 cm, with shoulders so broad that a doorway looks half as wide when he stands in it, long arms and a narrow waist. Short flaxen hair with a few tufts that always stick up; warm amber eyes; a light dusting of freckles over the nose; cheeks reddened by the wind at the shaft mouth; big hands with thick knuckles. A small palm-sized notebook of names in his chest pocket. A warm, talkative, soft-hearted air; he is the first to notice who is cold.
build: 186 cm, tall with unusually broad shoulders, long arms and a narrow waist; big hands with thick knuckles.
palette: flaxen gold and warm amber, deep brown, academy grey-green, a little bronze
casual: His travelling gear: the old travelling outfit issued by the adventurers' academy, a grey-green short coat and grey trousers, the cuffs frayed, a belt with a pouch, sturdy boots; a palm-sized notebook and a stub of charcoal pencil in the chest pocket; the guild's bronze laurel rank emblem, a laurel branch around the guild star, on a cord. Over his shoulders an old deep-brown cloak with sleeves, its hem patched three times. At his hip a standard-issue mountain-copper longsword, a few small marks scratched into its scabbard with a knife point. One big hand rests on the sword's pommel, a warm, open grin.
private: At home in the lanes outside the third wall: a cream wool shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a brown wool waistcoat, grey trousers and soft shoes, no cloak. He holds the little notebook open in his big hands, reading a name to himself. A quiet, earnest look.
battle: Holding a narrow passage: the academy outfit with a boiled-leather cuirass and shoulder guards over it, a bronze laurel badge on the strap, leather bracers with fine mountain-copper rune lines, the deep-brown sleeved cloak, sturdy boots. He holds the mountain-copper longsword in both hands low and forward, a pale copper shimmer along the blade, the broad shoulders squared. A firm, steady look.
formal: At the Ceasefire Day reading of names: a clean deep-blue wool coat buttoned to the collar over a white shirt, the bronze laurel emblem on its cord at the chest, the flaxen hair combed down with the tufts still sticking up, polished boots. He holds the little notebook closed against his chest with both hands, standing very straight, a serious, slightly anxious look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the amber eyes looking at the viewer with a warm, slightly embarrassed grin, one big hand holding up the open notebook. Warm lantern light from one side. Foreground blur: an old book falling open in the air, the edges of its pages ruled with small tally marks, and a loose fold of the brown cloak. He wears the deep-brown sleeved cloak over the academy outfit.

name: 韦塞林·填缝
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:901
who: Wesselin, a demon-kin priest of the bull-horned Thunder-Gaol folk who serves Obadis of the Earth, about a hundred and thirteen but looking thirty-five or thirty-six: about 208 cm, very tall, broad and thick, with a flat, level back; his horns stand higher than a door frame. Deep bronze-coloured skin. Two bull horns curving forward; the right one has an old crack filled smooth with mortar, a shade paler than the horn. Dark indigo hair in one thick braid down to the waist. Honey-coloured eyes that look at the ground under your feet before your face. Thick palms, the thumb pads worn smooth from testing cracks. A slow, steady, generous air.
build: 208 cm, very tall, broad and thick, with a flat, level back.
palette: earth ochre and honey gold, deep bronze, dark indigo, a little mortar grey
casual: His priest's dress: the long earth-yellow robe of the priests of Obadis, the cuffs tied with hemp cord, the knees patched layer on layer with leather from kneeling, a plain belt; at his waist a small bucket of mortar and an iron crack-filling trowel whose handle his grandfather wrapped with hemp cord; the guild's bronze key-and-door-ring rank emblem on a cord at his neck. He holds the trowel in one broad hand, looking down kindly, a patient look.
private: On the steps of the little chapel of the Seven: a plain long-sleeved oatmeal linen tunic with the sleeves rolled up, brown trousers patched at the knees, soft shoes, the braid over one shoulder. He holds the trowel with a little mortar on its blade, about to smooth a crack. A calm, contented look.
battle: Holding up the stone over his party: the earth-yellow robe belted over a boiled-leather jerkin, thick leather knee guards, the hemp-tied cuffs, the mortar bucket at his hip. One broad palm is held out flat and low toward the ground, the other hand grips the iron trowel; he carries no other weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and immovable, the feet planted wide and the knees a little bent as if bearing a great weight on his back, one broad palm held out flat and low toward the ground, the other hand gripping the iron trowel; he carries no other weapon.
formal: Full vestments for a rite of Obadis: a long earth-ochre robe to the floor, a deep brown stole embroidered along its edge with plain stone-and-beam shapes, a small worn stone tablet, the god's seal, hanging on a cord outside the robe, new hemp cords at his cuffs. He stands very upright with the broad hands folded in front, a serene, solemn look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the head bowed a little so the horns frame it, the honey-coloured eyes looking down at the viewer gently, the mortar-filled crack on the right horn clear. Warm earthy amber light rising from one side, like heat from a deep mine. Foreground blur: drifting steam, fine stone dust and the edge of a cracked stone. He wears the earth-yellow priest's robe.

name: 古德蒙·苔灯
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:957
who: Gudmund, a dwarf scout of the deep-mine folk of the forge city, from a family that lights its tunnels with glowing moss instead of fire, about a hundred and ninety and in a dwarf's prime: about 136 cm, short, broad and solid, thick-armed. A rust-red beard streaked with white, braided into three strands; the middle braid ends in a finger-sized glass vial holding a ball of moss that glows a cold blue-white, his lamp. An old felt hat with the brim pulled low. Moss-green eyes. Hard calluses on the knuckles of both hands from knocking on walls. A gruff, grumbling, soft-hearted air: he scolds first and helps after.
face: FACE, as in the references: a dwarf's face in the prime of life, broad and weathered, NOT old and NOT a child's: deep-set moss-green eyes under bushy rust-red brows; a big nose; ruddy cheeks; a grumbling mouth half hidden by the moustache; no glasses and no lens. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 136 cm, short, broad and solid, with thick arms and big knuckled hands.
palette: rust red and moss green, glowing blue-white, oilcloth olive, a little charcoal
casual: His scout's gear: an oilcloth short coat with pockets sewn on in layers over a thick wool shirt, dark trousers and heavy boots; at his belt a short pick, a leather pouch of dried mushrooms and a jar of moss sealed with wax, a bone scraper tucked beside it; the guild's bronze star-chart rank emblem on a cord at his neck; the old felt hat pulled low. He holds the short pick in one hand, the knuckles of the other raised as if about to knock on a wall, a grumbling, attentive look.
private: Cooking in camp: the oilcloth coat off, a thick wool shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a stained cook's apron, the felt hat pushed back. He holds a ladle and a small dented pot of steaming mushroom soup. A gruff, quietly pleased look.
battle: In a tunnel that is closing: the oilcloth coat buttoned over a boiled-leather jerkin, leather bracers, the felt hat pulled low, the moss jar open at his belt. He grips the short pick in his right hand, ready to strike, the moss vial at his beard glowing blue-white. A fierce, scolding look.
formal: At the Ceasefire Day reading of names: an old dark green wool coat brushed clean and buttoned up, the beard freshly braided with the moss vial at its tip, the bronze star-chart emblem on its cord. He holds the felt hat in both hands in front of him, bare-headed, standing very straight, a grave look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the glowing moss vial at the tip of his beard lighting his face from below with a cold blue-white glow, the moss-green eyes looking at the viewer from under the brim of the felt hat with a gruff, kind look. Foreground blur: smears of glowing moss on dark stone, drifting spores and a curl of soup steam. He wears the oilcloth short coat with its many pockets.

name: 比亚克·眠雷
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:1354
who: Bjarke, a demon-kin bell-carrier of the bull-horned Thunder-Gaol folk from the city of bone bells, now the old porter on the bench at the appraisal office door, about nine hundred and fifty-five but looking just over fifty: about 226 cm, so tall he ducks through every door, his shoulders as wide as one. Deep bronze-coloured skin. Two bull horns curving forward, each tip fitted with a copper cap, the bell-carrier's mark, so a horn never strikes a bell. Short-cropped dark green hair, gone mostly white. Turquoise eyes, the gaze a little lowered, as if afraid of frightening anyone. Hard calluses on both shoulders from bell frames. A gentle, apologetic, patient air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a demon-kin man's face of about fifty-two, broad, heavy-browed and gentle: deep-set turquoise eyes, the gaze a little lowered and kind, fine lines at their corners and across the brow; a broad nose; a mild, apologetic mouth. Deep bronze-coloured skin with very little shading, skin shadows a soft warm brown.

battle: On the wall: the old-fort mail, the iron-grey cloak with the scale clasp, leather gloves. She holds the round shield up in her left hand and the short spear in her right, the shoulders flat and set, the weight on the front foot, a stern, unblinking look.
formal: As a veteran of the wall on Ceasefire Day: an iron-grey wool officer's tunic with a rolled collar open at the throat and a pleated skirt to mid-thigh, old-fort pattern mail showing at the chest, a short cloak fastened with the polished scale clasp, a guild emblem on a cord, a small grey ward-rune on each cuff. She stands very upright with the hands folded in front, a grave look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the copper-gold slit-pupilled eyes looking up past the viewer into a night sky, unblinking. The warm orange light of a signal beacon from one side against the cold night. Foreground blur: beacon sparks, drifting snow and the polished scale clasp. She wears the iron-grey short cloak over the old mail.
art_extra: Her hair stays the same ash grey as in the sprite, NOT blue; the cold light does not tint it.

name: 克塞尼娅·抵门
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:1410
who: Ksenia, a demon-kin woman of the bull-horned Thunder-Gaol folk who carried a prison door on her back as her shield through the long war and hung it back on the gate of her city when the war ended, about two hundred and fifty and looking about forty: about 201 cm, broad-shouldered and thick-backed, her arms thicker than most men's legs. Deep bronze-coloured skin, with faint pale violet lines climbing her arms and neck that glow in a thunderstorm. Blue-black hair in one thick braid coiled between her horns. Two horns curving forward, wound round and round with thick hemp rope, bound tight. Copper-green eyes. A calm, steady, protective air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a mature woman's face of about forty, broad-boned and calm: medium almond eyes of copper green, fine lines at their corners; level dark brows; a firm, kind mouth. Deep bronze-coloured skin with very little shading, skin shadows a soft warm brown; faint pale violet lines run up the sides of the neck.
build: 201 cm, very tall and powerful: broad shoulders, a thick back, arms thicker than most men's legs, a very full bust, a solid waist and wide hips.
palette: deep bronze and storm violet, blue-black, copper green, pale hemp
casual: Her clothes at home in the Thunder-Gaol city: a short jacket of thunder-maned wolf pelt, worn against lightning, over a long dark grey linen tunic belted with a wide leather belt, dark trousers and heavy boots; the guild's bronze star-chart rank emblem on a cord at the belt; the hemp rope wound tight round both horns. Her big hands hang at her sides, a calm, protective look.
private: A quiet evening at home: a loose dark grey knitted tunic with long sleeves, wide trousers and soft boots, the braid let down. She holds a coil of new hemp rope, about to bind one of her horns again. A peaceful, patient look.
battle: Holding a line: dark heavy armour forged in the Thunder-Gaol, its plates scorched with lightning burns, leather straps across the back. She holds before her as a shield an iron prison door as tall as a person and half as wide, a row of rivets down its face and a palm-sized food slot at waist height with one bar bent, gripping it by its leather straps. A steady, immovable look.
formal: At the gate of the Thunder-Gaol on a day of release: a black wool surcoat worn over a dark mail shirt, studded with iron rivets in the shape of a gate, a small shield-shaped war badge and the star-chart emblem at the breast, new hemp rope bound tight on her horns, a heavy iron key hung at her belt, faint blue lightning that runs along the hems. She stands very upright with the hands folded in front, a grave, gentle look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the copper-green eyes calm, the pale violet lines on her neck glowing faintly. Violet-white storm light from one side. Foreground blur: rain streaks, the riveted edge of an iron door and a frayed end of hemp rope. She wears the thunder-wolf pelt jacket.
art_extra: Her hair is near-black with only a faint dark blue sheen, exactly as in the sprite, NOT purple or violet; it stays coiled in one braid between her horns with only two short locks hanging, no loose hair spread over her chest. Her eyes are the copper-green of the sprite, NOT yellow, gold or amber. Her hair is near-black with only a faint dark blue sheen, NOT purple or violet, even under the violet storm light, which only rims its outer edge; the hair stays coiled in one braid between her horns.

name: 莉齐·炭尾
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:1696
who: Lizzie, a fox-eared beastfolk woman, captain and map-drawer of the young party called Thirteen-Oh-Five, twenty-two: short and slight, quick on her feet. Bright orange-red hair cut short at the base of the ears, and a pair of fox ears of the same colour; a fluffy orange-red tail whose tip is a band of black, as in every one of her family of charcoal-sellers. Emerald-green eyes. A pen callus on the right middle finger and a little charcoal always under the nails. A flat leather case at her waist holding oil paper and three charcoal pencils. A quick, exact air: she writes the date on every map before anything else.
build: short and slight, quick on her feet.
palette: fox orange-red and emerald, charcoal black, oil-paper amber, a little bronze
casual: Her travelling clothes: the old travelling outfit issued by the adventurers' academy, a grey-green short coat with the cuffs worn soft, grey trousers and sturdy boots, a belt with a flat leather case holding oil paper and three charcoal pencils; the guild's bronze key-and-door-ring rank emblem on a cord. Her tail curls round one leg; she holds a sheet of oil paper and a charcoal pencil, a quick, bright look.
private: In the map room of the survey bureau after hours: a cream shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a dark green knitted vest, grey trousers and soft shoes, charcoal smudges on her fingers. She holds a half-finished map on oil paper against her chest, the tail sweeping behind her. A focused, pleased look.
battle: Leading her party into the deep: the academy outfit under a fitted leather jerkin, leather bracers, a coil of rope over one shoulder, the flat map case at her belt. She holds up in one hand a palm-sized, pale grey-white six-pointed key shaped like a star, glazed like porcelain, one point broken half off, and a charcoal pencil in the other; she carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the expedition outfit: alert and ready, the feet a little apart, a firm expression, holding up a small pale six-pointed star-shaped key in one hand and a charcoal pencil in the other; she carries no weapon.
formal: At the guild, renewing her party's name on the board: a clean dark green wool short jacket worn open over a white shirt and a small silk bow, the bronze guild emblem on its cord, a brass pencil-badge on the lapel, her hair combed and the tail brushed, a tiny glowing needle that points the way to the nearest star on her cuff. She holds a rolled map tied with a cord in both hands in front of her, standing very upright, a proud, slightly nervous look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the emerald eyes bright, the fox ears up, a sheet of oil paper held up beside her face with a sketch of three branching paths on it and no writing. Warm amber lamplight from one side, as from a map table. Foreground blur: drifting charcoal dust, the edge of a sheet of oil paper and a small pale star-shaped key. She wears the academy travelling outfit.

name: 露希亚
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:1713
who: Lucia, the last of the Dawn-Keeper remnant, a girl who grew up in the deep floors of the great dungeon and looks fifteen or sixteen: small, wholly covered by her clothes, moving without a sound. Shoulder-length silver hair, the ends always damp as if she had just walked out of fog. Misty blue eyes whose pupils open very wide in the dark and narrow to a thin line when a lamp is brought close. She speaks in few, short words and never lies. A quiet, wary, very still air; in any room she looks for the second exit first.
palette: silver and misty blue, slate grey-blue, deep brown, a little old iron
casual: Her clothes from the deep: a borrowed old deep-brown cloak with sleeves, far too big for her, its hem patched three times and brushing the ground, the sleeves rolled up three times; under it her own clothes of old cloth sewn together layer on layer in faded grey and slate blue, a long tunic to the shins over leggings, soft cloth-wrapped shoes. She holds in one hand the short bar of old iron she strikes at the hour. A quiet, watchful look.
private: On the open ground behind the east wall: the cloak off, her own layered patched clothes, a long-sleeved under-tunic with the cuffs tied, the damp silver hair loose. She holds a small cup of water from a living spring in both hands. A calm, faraway look.
battle: Ready for the deep roads: the long brown cloak belted at the waist with a cord to keep it off the ground, the sleeves rolled, her layered clothes tied close at the wrists and ankles. She holds the short iron bar low in one hand and does not fight. A wary, alert look.
battle_pose: 3) the deep-road outfit: wary and ready, the shoulders drawn in, the feet light and a little apart as if about to step back toward an exit, holding the short iron bar low in one hand; she does not fight.
formal: The oldest thing she owns, the night-watch coat of her people: a long dark slate-blue coat with a high collar, worn thin and darned many times, a small bell stitched in faded silver thread at the collar, buttoned to the throat over her layered clothes. She stands very upright with both hands holding the short iron bar in front of her, a solemn, quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the misty blue eyes with wide dark pupils looking at the viewer quietly and steadily, the damp silver hair framing the face. Cold grey-blue light of the hour before dawn from one side. Foreground blur: drifting mist, small drops of water and a piece of old iron hanging from a beam. She wears the borrowed deep-brown cloak with the sleeves rolled up, closed at the collar.
art_extra: Her shoulder-length hair is the silver grey of the sprite, on its lit side and its shadow side alike; its shadows a darker neutral grey, NOT blue, violet, lavender or pink; the coloured light only rims its outermost edge.
